Prediction and variable importance with synthetic data

Si Cheng

2022-03-07

Data generation

We choose 5 ``active’’ predictors in our mean model, which are

  • Distance to A1 road
  • Population density
  • NDVI (annual median, buffer size 1km)
  • Land use - urban (buffer size 15km)
  • Land use - residential (buffer size 15km)

and they do not seem to be highly auto-correlated (despite bimodal / unbalanced distribution):

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)

set.seed(3)

plltnt.mat <- read.csv("C:/Users/Si Cheng/Dropbox (Personal)/exposurepred/spatialRF/data/Si.txt")
plltnt.mat <- plltnt.mat[-which(plltnt.mat$native_id=="PHOE5"),]
# annavg.si <- plltnt.mat[,2]
X <- plltnt.mat[,c(14:25,27:613)]
X.active <- X %>% select(m_to_a1, pop_dens, ndvi_q50_a01000,
                         lu_mix_urban_p15000, lu_resi_p15000)

ggpairs(X.active)

We then generate the data with a non-linear mean model and exponential covariance model, with roughly comparable heterogeneity between them. The mean model is (after properly standardizing/shifting all predictors) \[ Y_{\text{mean}} = -0.5\cdot\text{Dist to A1} + 0.2\cdot\text{Pop density}^2 - 1\cdot \text{median NDVI} + 0.5\cdot\sqrt{\text{Urban landuse}} + 0.5\cdot\text{Residential landuse} -0.25\cdot\text{Dist to A1}\times\text{Median NDVI}. \]

grid <- list(lambert_x = plltnt.mat$lambert_x,
             lambert_y = plltnt.mat$lambert_y)
coords <- list(x = scale(grid$lambert_x), 
               y = scale(grid$lambert_y))

X1 = X.active %>% mutate_each(funs(scale)) %>% 
    mutate(pop_dens = ifelse(pop_dens > 2, 2, pop_dens)) %>%
    mutate(lu_mix_urban_p15000 = ifelse(lu_mix_urban_p15000 > 3, 3, lu_mix_urban_p15000))
y.mean = X1$m_to_a1 * (-.5) + X1$pop_dens^2 * .2 +
    X1$ndvi_q50_a01000 * (-1) + 
    sqrt(X1$lu_mix_urban_p15000 - min(X1$lu_mix_urban_p15000)) * .5 +
    X1$lu_resi_p15000 * .5 + X1$m_to_a1*X1$ndvi_q50_a01000 * (-.25)

gen.data = function(sig, nug, range){
  dmat = SpatioTemporal::crossDist(cbind(coords$x, coords$y))
  cov.mat = sig * exp(-dmat/range) + nug * diag(nrow(X))
  
  y.err = MASS::mvrnorm(n = 1, mu = rep(0, length(y.mean)), Sigma = cov.mat)
  return(y.err = y.err)
}

ggplot(data = NULL, aes(x = y.mean)) + geom_histogram() +
  ggtitle("Mean component of the outcome")
## `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value with `binwidth`.

y.err = gen.data(sig = 2, nug = 1.5, range = 10)
knitr::kable(t(c(var(y.mean), var(y.err))), col.names = c("Mean", "Cov"),
             digits = 4, caption = "Variance of each component")
Variance of each component
Mean Cov

Prediction

10-fold cross-validation was conducted to assess the performance of different models on this data:

load("C:/Users/Si Cheng/Dropbox (Personal)/exposurepred/spatialRF/syn_rslt.RData")
Y.pls = Y.spatrf.cv = Y.spatrf.pl = Y.rf = Y.tprs = Y.rf.tprs = Y.tprs.rf = 
  rep(NA, length(y.mean))

for (j in 1:length(rslt)){
  idx <- !is.na(rslt[[j]]$Y.pls)
  Y.pls[idx] <- rslt[[j]]$Y.pls[idx]
  Y.spatrf.cv[idx] <- rslt[[j]]$Y.spatrf.cv[idx]
  Y.spatrf.pl[idx] <- rslt[[j]]$Y.spatrf.pl[idx]
  Y.rf[idx] = rslt[[j]]$Y.rf[idx]
  Y.tprs[idx] = rslt[[j]]$Y.tprs[idx]
  Y.rf.tprs[idx] = rslt[[j]]$Y.rf.tprs[idx]
  Y.tprs.rf[idx] = rslt[[j]]$Y.tprs.rf[idx]
}

r2 = matrix(c(1 - mean((Y.pls^2 - annavg^2)^2)/var(annavg^2),
              1 - mean((Y.spatrf.pl^2 - annavg^2)^2)/var(annavg^2),

              1 - mean((Y.tprs.rf^2 - annavg^2)^2)/var(annavg^2)), nrow = 1)

Visualization of the generated data and predictions:

library(ggmap)
library(ggpubr)

make_plot = function(use.residual = FALSE, transformed = c("sqrt", "log", "none"),
                     y, y.true = NULL, plot.range, coords, plot.title){
  if (transformed == "sqrt"){
    y = y^2
    if (!is.null(y.true)) y.true = y.true^2
  } else if(transformed == "log"){
    y = exp(y)
    if (!is.null(y.true)) y.true = y.true^2
  }
  
  if (use.residual){
    y = y - y.true
  }
  
  dt = as.data.frame(cbind(y, coords$longitude, coords$latitude))
  colnames(dt) = c("y", "longitude", "latitude")
  
  usMap = get_map(location=c(min(coords$longitude), min(coords$latitude),
                            max(coords$longitude), max(coords$latitude)),
                 source="stamen", maptype = "terrain", crop=FALSE)

  p = ggmap(usMap) + 
         geom_jitter(data = dt, 
                    aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = y))
  
  if (use.residual){
    p = p + scale_color_gradient2(name = "", limits = plot.range)
  } else{
    p = p + scale_color_viridis_c(option = "cividis", name = "", trans = "sqrt",
                                  limits = plot.range) 
  }
  
  p = p + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min(dt$longitude)-2,
                                       max(dt$longitude)+2), 
                            expand = c(0, 0)) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min(dt$latitude)-2,
                                       max(dt$latitude)+2), 
                            expand = c(0, 0)) +
      guides(size = FALSE) + ggtitle(plot.title)
  return(p)
}

res.range = range(c(Y.pls^2 - annavg^2, Y.spatrf.pl^2 - annavg^2, Y.spatrf.cv^2 - annavg^2, 
                    Y.rf^2 - annavg^2, Y.tprs^2 - annavg^2, Y.rf.tprs^2 - annavg^2, Y.tprs.rf^2 - annavg^2))
latlon = list(longitude = plltnt.mat$longitude, latitude = plltnt.mat$latitude)

p = make_plot(use.residual = FALSE, transformed = "sqrt", 
          y = annavg, y.true = NULL, plot.range = c(0, (max(annavg) - min(annavg))^2), 
          coords = latlon, plot.title = "Pollutant")
p.pls = make_plot(use.residual = TRUE, transformed = "sqrt", 
          y = Y.pls, y.true = annavg, plot.range = res.range, 
          coords = latlon, plot.title = "UK-PLS")
p.spatrf.pl = make_plot(use.residual = TRUE, transformed = "sqrt", 
          y = Y.spatrf.pl, y.true = annavg, plot.range = res.range,
          coords = latlon, plot.title = "SpatRF-PL")
p.spatrf.cv = make_plot(use.residual = TRUE, transformed = "sqrt", 
          y = Y.spatrf.cv, y.true = annavg, plot.range = res.range,
          coords = latlon, plot.title = "SpatRF-NP")
p.rf = make_plot(use.residual = TRUE, transformed = "sqrt", 
          y = Y.rf, y.true = annavg, plot.range = res.range, 
          coords = latlon, plot.title = "RF")
p.tprs = make_plot(use.residual = TRUE, transformed = "sqrt", 
          y = Y.tprs, y.true = annavg, plot.range = res.range, 
          coords = latlon, plot.title = "TPRS")
p.rf.tprs = make_plot(use.residual = TRUE, transformed = "sqrt", 
          y = Y.rf.tprs, y.true = annavg, plot.range = res.range, 
          coords = latlon, plot.title = "RF-TPRS")
p.tprs.rf = make_plot(use.residual = TRUE, transformed = "sqrt", 
          y = Y.tprs.rf, y.true = annavg, plot.range = res.range, 
          coords = latlon, plot.title = "TPRS-RF")

ggarrange(p,p.pls,p.spatrf.pl,p.spatrf.cv, p.rf,p.tprs,p.rf.tprs,p.tprs.rf,
            nrow = 4, ncol = 2, common.legend = FALSE, legend = "right")

Variable Importance

Recalling the mean model, we see that spatial RF captures this mechanism reasonably well. \[ Y_{\text{mean}} = -0.5\cdot\text{Dist to A1} + 0.2\cdot\text{Pop density}^2 - 1\cdot \text{median NDVI} + 0.5\cdot\sqrt{\text{Urban landuse}} + 0.5\cdot\text{Residential landuse} -0.25\cdot\text{Dist to A1}\times\text{Median NDVI}. \]

library(tidyverse)

load("varimp_syn.RData")
source("vip_function.R")

cols = 1:ncol(X)
qs = c(.25, .5, .75)

avg.pls = avg.spatrf = matrix(NA, ncol = length(qs), nrow = ncol(X))
avg.true = matrix(0, ncol = length(qs), nrow = ncol(X))

meanmod = function(x)
  x[1] * (-.5) + x[2]^2 * .2 + x[3] * (-1) + 
    sqrt(x[4] - min(X1$lu_mix_urban_p15000)) * .5 + x[5] * .5 + x[1]*x[3] * (-.25)

means <- apply(X.active,2,mean)
mean.matrix <- matrix(rep(means,nrow(X.active)),nrow=nrow(X.active),byrow=T)
sds <- apply(X.active,2,sd)

for (i in 1:ncol(X1)){
  for (j in 1:length(qs)){
    k = which(colnames(X) == colnames(X1)[i])
    X.active.temp = X.active
    X.active.temp[,i] = quantile(X.active[,i], qs[j])
    X.active.temp = as.matrix(X.active.temp - mean.matrix) %*% diag(1/sds) %>% as.data.frame()
    colnames(X.active.temp) = colnames(X.active)
    X1.qt = X.active.temp %>% as.data.frame() %>%
      # mutate_each(funs(scale2)) %>% 
      mutate(pop_dens = ifelse(pop_dens > 2, 2, pop_dens)) %>%
      mutate(lu_mix_urban_p15000 = ifelse(lu_mix_urban_p15000 > 3, 3, lu_mix_urban_p15000))
    # X1.qt = X1
    # X1.qt[,i] = quantile(X1[,i], qs[j])
    avg.true[k,j] = mean((apply(FUN = meanmod, X = X1.qt, MARGIN = 1) +
                            y.err - min(y.mean + y.err)) ^ 2)
  }
}

k = 1
for (i in cols){
  for (j in 1:length(qs)){
    avg.pls[i,j] = mean(rslt.syn$Y.pls[,k]^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    avg.spatrf[i,j] = mean(rslt.syn$Y.spatrf.cv[,k]^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    k = k + 1
  }
}

plotImp2(cbind((avg.pls[,2]) - (avg.pls[,1]), 
              (avg.spatrf[,2]) - (avg.spatrf[,1]),
              (avg.true[,2]) - (avg.true[,1])),
         cbind((avg.pls[,3]) - (avg.pls[,2]), 
              (avg.spatrf[,3]) - (avg.spatrf[,2]),
              (avg.true[,3]) - (avg.true[,2])),
         cbind((avg.pls[,3]) - (avg.pls[,1]), 
              (avg.spatrf[,3]) - (avg.spatrf[,1]),
              (avg.true[,3]) - (avg.true[,1])),
        "Predictors with Top Contribution, Synthetic Outcome", n_top = 5)
